channel.title: The Bridge India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Bridge India (thebridge.in)

item.title: Savita Punia absent as India names squad for FIH Hockey World Cup 2026 Qualifiers
item.description: Salima Tete to captain hosts India in Hyderabad with three World Cup spots on offer in March tournament.

item.title: Nirupama Mankad, the woman who walked into Wimbledon before India was ready for her
item.description: Long before the spotlight found Indian women’s tennis, Nirupama Mankad broke barriers by becoming the first Indian woman in the modern era to feature in a Grand Slam main draw.

item.title: India Women suffer 185-run defeat to Australia, concede ODI series 3-0
item.description: Alyssa Healy’s 158 and Beth Mooney’s unbeaten 106 power Australia to 409 as India are bowled out for 224 in Hobart.

item.title: No Indian in top 10 of March 2026 FIDE ratings as Gukesh slips to 11th
item.description: Gukesh, rated 2748, is currently the highest-ranked Indian in the classical list; Humpy fifth among women.

item.title: Modern Pythian Games to make history in Bishkek
item.description: India to field 65-member delegation at the 1st Youth Delphic Games in Kyrgyzstan.

item.title: Krishna Jayasankar crosses the 17m mark in shot put
item.description: The 23-year-old Indian shot putter recorded a lifetime best of 17.09m to break the indoor National Record.

item.title: Indian Super Gaming League announced
item.description: India’s first franchise-based National Esports league will feature 8 teams across 5 esports games.

item.title: MoS Sports Raksha Khadse announces nationwide ASMITA League
item.description: Nationwide athletic league to be conducted at 250 locations to celebrate International Women’s Day on March 8.

item.title: All England Championships 2026 Preview: Lakshya Sen to lead India's quest
item.description: India’s complete preview for the All England Badminton Championships 2026; full squad, first-round clashes, Lakshya Sen’s big test, doubles medal hopes and the impact of PV Sindhu’s absence.

item.title: Indian women wrestlers are staying match-ready in Tirana
item.description: Stranded in Tirana, the Indian women wrestling team turn travel disruptions into training opportunity.
